title: 对角线上的质数
summary: 在正方形矩阵主对角线与副对角线的元素中，返回最大的质数；不存在则返回零。
insight: 只需枚举每一行的 grid[i][i] 与 grid[i][n-1-i]，用试除到平方根判断质数并维护最大值。
pitfalls: 奇数阶中心元素会被检查两次但不影响答案

solutions.title: 扫描双对角线并试除判质数
solutions.idea: 检查至多 2n 个候选值。
steps: 实现 isPrime：小于二为 false，枚举 divisor<=value/divisor
i 从零到 n-1，检查主对角与副对角两个值

code.java: class Solution { private boolean isPrime(int value){if(value<2)return false;for(int divisor=2;divisor<=value/divisor;divisor++)if(value%divisor==0)return false;return true;}public int diagonalPrime(int[][] nums){int answer=0,n=nums.length;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(isPrime(nums[i][i]))answer=Math.max(answer,nums[i][i]);if(isPrime(nums[i][n-1-i]))answer=Math.max(answer,nums[i][n-1-i]);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun isPrime(value:Int):Boolean{if(value<2)return false;var divisor=2;while(divisor<=value/divisor){if(value%divisor==0)return false;divisor++};return true}fun diagonalPrime(nums:Array<IntArray>):Int{var answer=0;val n=nums.size;for(i in 0 until n){if(isPrime(nums[i][i]))answer=maxOf(answer,nums[i][i]);if(isPrime(nums[i][n-1-i]))answer=maxOf(answer,nums[i][n-1-i])};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool isPrime(int value){if(value<2)return false;for(int divisor=2;divisor<=value/divisor;++divisor)if(value%divisor==0)return false;return true;}public:int diagonalPrime(vector<vector<int>>& nums){int answer=0,n=nums.size();for(int i=0;i<n;++i){if(isPrime(nums[i][i]))answer=max(answer,nums[i][i]);if(isPrime(nums[i][n-1-i]))answer=max(answer,nums[i][n-1-i]);}return answer;} };
